items.title: ‘More orange than ever’: Michael Saylor’s Strategy buys 334 bitcoin for $28.7 million as total holdings top 848,000 BTC

items.title: Metaplanet sold 10,000 BTC in Q3 before buying back 11,000 BTC to ‘demonstrate liquidity’

items.title: Injective CEO Eric Chen expects US INJ ETFs to launch sooner than 2027
